facts.text: Adrian College pioneered a national model for student financial safety nets through its Loan Repayment Assistance Program (LRAP), branded as AdrianPlus / The Freedom Plan.

sources.title: National Call to Action | Adrian College | Liberal Arts College in MI
sources.quote: For five years, Adrian College pioneered a national model for student financial safety nets through its Loan Repayment Assistance Program (LRAP), branded as AdrianPlus / The Freedom Plan.

facts.text: In early April each year, the Adrian College campus convenes for the Ribbons of Excellence Conference to celebrate student scholarly and creative activities.

sources.title: Ribbons of Excellence | Adrian College | Liberal Arts College in MI
sources.quote: In early April each year, the Adrian College campus and surrounding communities will convene to celebrate the scholarly and creative activities of Adrian College students.
